title: 秋林浮光 · 风动修正版
revision: Correct the previous whole-image translation and shearing that made the rooted woodland drift like fabric.
production: Local procedural GIF animation of an existing native image; no new image generation or video-generation service used.

motion.foliageMotion: Small periodic leaf-surface displacement, spatially phased across the frame to suggest a coherent breeze
motion.mask: Conservative colour-and-luminance foliage mask eroded by one pixel; dark wood and low-chroma branches are protected. This is not semantic segmentation.
motion.lighting: Small leaf-only variations, synchronized with the travelling breeze
motion.stationaryAreas: Zero-mask pixels are copied directly from the original in every rendered frame

limitations: A 2D animated interpretation, not a physically simulated forest or AI-generated video. Colour masking does not establish a semantic guarantee that every branch pixel is stationary.
